content:
Less is more, and that's exactly how I use my Apple Watch. For me, the best experience requires fewer notifications and a deliberate focus on what I actually want from the device. This same approach applies to my Apple Watch face. While watchOS 27 doesn't bring any new watch faces for the time being, I've long been a fan of a stripped-down version of a very information-dense face.

A more modular, less Ultra version of the Modular Ultra face

Modular Ultra is exclusive to the Apple Watch Ultra, and it's a face that can take on a dramatically different appearance depending on your configuration.

My setup prioritizes a large display of the time, with seconds visible. The experience is particularly good on the Apple Watch Ultra 3, because it shows seconds continuously in both normal mode and Always On Display.

The complication in the lower-left corner shows the current temperature along with the low and high. The complication in the upper-right currently displays my Activity rings, though I sometimes swap out this slot depending on my preference. I occasionally replace it with the UV index.

The remaining four small complication slots are left empty. I enjoy the diagonal sense of balance and the effect created by the negative space.

You can configure Modular Ultra to show much more data

As a demonstration of what Modular Ultra is capable of displaying, I've also set up a version that showcases its full functionality.

It can show six fine complications, one medium complication below a smaller clock, and bezel data including seconds, depth, elevation, or training load.

I think it's pretty amazing that the Modular Ultra face can display so much information. But for my everyday needs, the stripped-down version actually benefits me more.

There's a quirky little detail about this face in its minimalist configuration: the placement of the red notification dot. Because it's positioned to accommodate the top-center complication slot, in my watch face layout, that dot isn't centered. Actually, this is yet another reason I like this layout: it's a little odd, and at the same time, distinctive.

Which watch face have you been loving lately? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.

The Apple Watch Ultra 3 is currently on sale on Amazon for $699 (down from $799). Apple's certified refurbished store also has the Apple Watch Ultra 2 available for $589.
